notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power X or greater, or you have a creature card in your graveyard with power X or greater.
description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Ambitious Dragonborn.
When Ambitious Dragonborn dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
